publicPurchases.practiceCitation: FAR 37.101 service-contract definition identifies maintenance/housekeeping services. This federal public-practice example does not enact local law. Generated opening local authority and appropriation are explicitly ESTIMATED. https://www.acquisition.gov/far/37.101

outsideHouseholds.citation: SCF 2022 family income is context only; https://www.bls.gov/cex/tables/calendar-year/mean/cu-all-detail-2024.xlsx, B1401 supplies an estimated standing lodging amount. Census actual shared-county place/population records establish geography only. Independent saved identity and visit-agreement records establish the modeled payer and due scope, not measured visit demand or wealth.
outsideHouseholds.openingFundingRole: zero-stock-dated-obligation-flow; SCF wealth is not an opening stock, recurring income or payment authority
outsideHouseholds.identityScope: Default IDs are distinct ESTIMATED synthetic edge identities; only an explicitly supplied actual owner/identity mapping deduplicates families across edges.

remainingUnsupported: Gasoline or drug/medical-product sales without recorded product-compatible suppliers; no general store becomes a gas station/pharmacy.
Hospital insurer/Medicare/Medicaid purchases, nursing-home residence bills and private-school tuition without recorded provider/beneficiary/enrollment scope.
Manufacturing, agriculture, quarry, construction and trucking external demand without product scope and independently funded buyer needs.
Tax/aid income, firm financing, loan/capital receipts and public institution funding remain owned by other producers.

Default outside-market Census county join covers the 50 states and D.C.; caller-supplied actual geographic visit records support other places through the same rule. Missing joins are disclosed, with household services using labeled national priors.

Insurance and realty purchases without actual insured risk/policy or property/customer agreement, product scope, price and qualifications. No payroll projection becomes an invoice. SG-P8-outside-product-demand-crosswalk remains open for every unqualified business class.
customerCalendarRole: Fresh household components use the actual owned work or recipient-income calendar, with a sourced explicit fallback only when no wage/income calendar is admitted. Public and visitor modeled agreements retain their own explicit next-period-month dates. Actual supplied terms and ends are preserved; statistical source years imply no expiry.

enterprise:transportation.missingSourceInputs: Actual shipper/customer, origin/destination and freight service/order, carrier qualification, due freight price/quantity and delivery/payment basis. CFS shipment value is not a carrier invoice or a freight-service price.

enterprise:agriculture.missingSourceInputs: Actual crop/livestock/product and producer scope, qualified buyer/market and dated quantity/price. General agricultural classification is not proof of a product, harvest or demand.

enterprise:construction.missingSourceInputs: Actual project/property/client, construction agreement, stage/retainer/progress terms and dated payable. No generic county public works award follows from the firm name.

enterprise:insurance.missingSourceInputs: Actual policy/client and licensed service/provider role, commission or service-fee terms and date. Agency/broker fees must stay distinct from insurer premium pools and risk claims.

enterprise:real-estate.missingSourceInputs: Actual property/client/transaction and broker service with commission/fee amount and due event. A realty service receipt is not property capital or a household rent bill.

enterprise:manufacturing.missingSourceInputs: Actual produced commodity/product scope, qualified plant/provider, independent buyer need/order and due quantity/price. Payroll-derived projected demand supplies no order or payer authority.

service:nursing-home.missingSourceInputs: Actual resident/beneficiary and care agreement, qualified provider/service interval, real private/program payer and dated terms. No Medicare/Medicaid or universal public payer is inferred.

enterprise:mining.missingSourceInputs: Actual mineral/aggregate product and buyer order, qualified supplier, dated quantity and price. Commodity flow categories require an explicit product crosswalk.

service:private-school.missingSourceInputs: Actual pupil/enrollment and school/provider, tuition period and due amount, real guardian/scholarship payer. Private enrollment is not generated public-school payroll authority.
